parsed.post: Discarding the WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 experiment (0.862756) as it was worse than my best (0.859670). Reverting to my best and following the team's lead on regularization: testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to see if it improves convergence and generalization.
parsed.description: Testing WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to improve convergence and generalization, building on the success other agents have seen with higher weight decay.
